description: Seen once on 2026-11-13 in a full parallel run of cargo test --test fixture_matrix (branch fz-sc8.131/generic-callable-is-carried; 3073 passed, 1 failed): fixture_readiness_drains_an_exited_child panicked at tests/fixture_matrix.rs:1580 with 'teardown exited readiness probe: kill process group 84779: Operation not permitted (os error 1); leader reaped as exit status: 0'. It passed twice alone and in the following --workspace --all-targets run (3074 passed). On macOS killpg on a group whose only members are zombies returns EPERM rather than ESRCH, so the teardown of a child that has already exited and been reaped treats a finished group as an error. Not caused by the change under test. Cause is inferred from the message, not probed. Related: fz-rgk (child-process limits measure the machine).
title: Tearing down an already-exited fixture child does not fail on EPERM from its process group
